# OurWord (OurWord)

> 159 people and books on how the world actually works, across 2,600 years
> See how people before you handled it.

A knowledge base of the durable rules people have worked out about strategy, money, power, human nature and building things — drawn from 159 figures and classic texts across 2,600 years. Each entry gives the one idea that person is actually remembered for, the story behind it, the sub-principles with worked examples, and how it applies today.

## Read it

- Site: https://ourword.ai/en/
- Everything on one page: https://ourword.ai/en/all/
- Every entry has its own static page: https://ourword.ai/en/i/<slug>/
- Full text of everything, one file: https://ourword.ai/en/llms-full.txt
- All URLs: https://ourword.ai/en/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://ourword.ai/en/feed.xml

## Deep reads

Long-form chapters hanging off a person page. Not part of the entry index above.

- [Alfred Adler · Whose task is this](https://ourword.ai/en/i/adler/separation-of-tasks/): Alfred Adler · Whose task is this — Draw the line where the bill lands. Most of the pain in a relationship comes from crossing a line nobody drew. This is where the line actually runs.
- [Alfred Adler · Not because — in order to](https://ourword.ai/en/i/adler/teleology/): Alfred Adler · Not because — in order to — Swap the cause for the purpose. Freud asks what happened to you. Adler asks what you are using it for. Why changing the question unfreezes things.
- [The Analects · Knowing what you know](https://ourword.ai/en/i/analects/know-what-you-know/): The Analects · Knowing what you know — The half that has to be said out loud. Read as modesty it is a platitude. Read as an instruction it is an operation that very few people can actually perform.
- [The Analects · Three layers of looking at a person](https://ourword.ai/en/i/analects/see-how/): The Analects · Three layers of looking at a person — Each layer is harder to fake than the last. Everyone misreads people. The useful part of his method is the order: the three layers get progressively harder to perform.
- [The Analects · Do not do it to them](https://ourword.ai/en/i/analects/reciprocity/): The Analects · Do not do it to them — The one word he said would last a lifetime. Zigong asked for a single word to live by. The part worth noticing is that what came back was a prohibition.
- [The Analects · Harmony is not sameness](https://ourword.ai/en/i/analects/harmony-not-sameness/): The Analects · Harmony is not sameness — Agreement and consent are different things. Nobody objected in the meeting. That is usually not agreement, and the distinction he draws says what it is instead.
- [Hannah Arendt · The banality of evil](https://ourword.ai/en/i/arendt/banality-of-evil/): Hannah Arendt · The banality of evil — Not wicked, just not thinking. What kind of state is I only follow the list and never ask why. What she saw in the courtroom changed her mind.
- [Hannah Arendt · Stopping to think is your own job](https://ourword.ai/en/i/arendt/thinking-as-a-duty/): Hannah Arendt · Stopping to think is your own job — It cannot be outsourced. When the rules are someone else's and everyone around you complies, what is left. Why she calls thinking a duty rather than a talent.
- [Hannah Arendt · New York at thirty-five](https://ourword.ai/en/i/arendt/new-york-at-35/): Hannah Arendt · New York at thirty-five — No English, no papers, start again. New country, new language, no standing. What she had with her when she landed, what she did not, and what she did first.
- [The Art of Worldly Wisdom · Leave while you are winning](https://ourword.ai/en/i/art-of-worldly-wisdom/quit-while-winning/): The Art of Worldly Wisdom · Leave while you are winning — A long run of luck is the warning. Everyone reads it as timidity. Read as written it is a gambler's arithmetic: a long winning run is the thing to distrust.
- [The Art of Worldly Wisdom · Do, and be seen doing](https://ourword.ai/en/i/art-of-worldly-wisdom/do-and-be-seen/): The Art of Worldly Wisdom · Do, and be seen doing — Half the work is being known to have done it. The maxim is uncomfortable coming from a priest. What it argues is not vanity but arithmetic about whose ledger your work sits on.
- [Atomic Habits · Fall to the Level of Your Systems](https://ourword.ai/en/i/atomic-habits/systems-over-goals/): Atomic Habits · Fall to the Level of Your Systems — Goals do not separate winners from losers. Every team in the race wants to win it. What Clear says the difference actually is.
- [Atomic Habits · Start from Identity](https://ourword.ai/en/i/atomic-habits/identity-first/): Atomic Habits · Start from Identity — Do not wrestle the craving. Anything given up by willpower usually comes back. Whether there is a route that does not need the fight.
- [Attachment Theory · The information is in the reunion](https://ourword.ai/en/i/attachment-theory/strange-situation/): Attachment Theory · The information is in the reunion — Not crying is not the same as not frightened. The baby who screams when the mother leaves may not be the most frightened one in the room. Which moment to watch.
- [Attachment Theory · A secure base](https://ourword.ai/en/i/attachment-theory/secure-base/): Attachment Theory · A secure base — You go far only if you can come back. Why some people will take a risk and others will not. The condition that has to be in place before nerve is available.
- [Augustine · Grant me chastity, but not yet](https://ourword.ai/en/i/augustine/not-yet/): Augustine · Grant me chastity, but not yet — The oldest sentence about putting it off. Everyone quotes the prayer as a joke. Read it in place and it is an exact account of how postponement works.
- [Augustine · The pears](https://ourword.ai/en/i/augustine/the-pear-tree/): Augustine · The pears — Not for the fruit, for the theft. A man in his forties spends pages on a boyhood theft of fruit he did not even eat. The question is why.
- [Augustine · The mind commands itself and is resisted](https://ourword.ai/en/i/augustine/the-mind-commands/): Augustine · The mind commands itself and is resisted — Not a weak will, two of them. He notices something strange in the garden: the body obeys instantly and the will does not. His explanation is a mechanism, not a scolding.
- [Bai Gui · Take what the others drop](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bai-gui/take-what-others-drop/): Bai Gui · Take what the others drop — Buy in the good year, sell in the lean one. Everyone knows buy low, sell high. What is missing is the part that makes it something a person can actually execute.
- [Bai Gui · Four things, and no waivers](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bai-gui/four-qualifications/): Bai Gui · Four things, and no waivers — Missing one and the other three stop paying. He put trade on a level with statecraft and war, and then set an entrance requirement that most applicants would fail.
- [Jeff Bezos · Always Day 1](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bezos/day-one/): Jeff Bezos · Always Day 1 — What Day 2 looks like. Someone asked what Day 2 would look like. The answer, and the four parts he installed to keep it away.
- [Jeff Bezos · Bet on what will not change](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bezos/what-wont-change/): Jeff Bezos · Bet on what will not change — The question almost nobody asks. Everyone asks him what the next ten years will change. He says the more useful question is the one he almost never gets.
- [The Bhagavad Gita · A right to the action, never to the fruit](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bhagavad-gita/right-to-the-act/): The Bhagavad Gita · A right to the action, never to the fruit — Chapter two, verse forty-seven. Two thousand years of quotation have made it sound like detachment. In place it is a boundary line drawn under pressure.
- [The Bhagavad Gita · Standing still in front of the line](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bhagavad-gita/frozen-on-the-field/): The Bhagavad Gita · Standing still in front of the line — He saw it clearly and that is why he stopped. The book opens with a man who cannot move, and spends eighteen chapters on him. That structure is the argument.
- [The Bhagavad Gita · Do it without gripping it](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bhagavad-gita/act-without-clinging/): The Bhagavad Gita · Do it without gripping it — Not the same as not caring. Action without desire gets read as coldness. What it actually separates are two things that usually travel together.
- [Otto von Bismarck · Iron and blood](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bismarck/iron-and-blood/): Otto von Bismarck · Iron and blood — Naming the currency a question settles in. One of the most quoted speeches in Europe was delivered in a small room. What he was arguing about there was money.
- [Otto von Bismarck · The art of the possible](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bismarck/art-of-the-possible/): Otto von Bismarck · The art of the possible — Three wins, then the brake. After three quick victories he spent twenty years preventing the next war. Stopping was the part that took more from him than winning.
- [BJ Fogg · Small Enough for Your Worst Day](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bj-fogg/tiny-habits/): BJ Fogg · Small Enough for Your Worst Day — Do not bet on motivation. On the day you decide, anything is possible. The problem is the day with nothing in the tank. What to do then.
- [BJ Fogg · Anchor It, Then Celebrate](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bj-fogg/anchor-and-celebrate/): BJ Fogg · Anchor It, Then Celebrate — Prompt and emotion. Forgetting to do it and doing it without it sticking are two different faults. How each one is fixed.
- [Murray Bowen · In the relationship and still yourself](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bowen/differentiation/): Murray Bowen · In the relationship and still yourself — Fusion and cut-off are the same failure. With family it is either being swept along or getting out. Whether there is a third road.
- [Murray Bowen · Pulling in a third person](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bowen/triangles/): Murray Bowen · Pulling in a third person — The tension gets fixed in place. A problem between two people always seems to end up being three people's problem. What that costs.
- [John Boyd · The OODA loop](https://ourword.ai/en/i/boyd/ooda/): John Boyd · The OODA loop — Fast means turning, not moving. He was a fighter instructor who could win from any position in forty seconds. What 'fast' meant in the loop he built.
- [John Boyd · To be somebody, or to do something](https://ourword.ai/en/i/boyd/to-be-or-to-do/): John Boyd · To be somebody, or to do something — The fork in the road. He made colonel and never rose again. The speech he gave every young officer who wanted to follow him.
- [Brené Brown · Guilt is workable, shame is not](https://ourword.ai/en/i/brene-brown/guilt-not-shame/): Brené Brown · Guilt is workable, shame is not — Look at what the sentence in your head is pointing at. One mistake, two sentences a few words apart. What separates them, and why the consequences run in opposite directions.
- [Brené Brown · The three things shame needs](https://ourword.ai/en/i/brene-brown/secrecy-silence-judgment/): Brené Brown · The three things shame needs — Secrecy, silence and judgment, and how each comes apart. Shame is not a weather system but a mechanism with conditions. Which three it needs, and how you take each one away.
- [Bruce Lee · Be like water](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bruce-lee/be-water/): Bruce Lee · Be like water — Shape follows the container. The line is on film, so it is not something admirers put in his mouth later. What it describes is an operation.
- [Bruce Lee · One kick, ten thousand times](https://ourword.ai/en/i/bruce-lee/one-kick/): Bruce Lee · One kick, ten thousand times — Which repetition, and in which direction. A man famous for speed and variety left behind a sentence about repetition. The two are not in tension.
- [Warren Buffett · The circle of competence](https://ourword.ai/en/i/buffett/circle-of-competence/): Warren Buffett · The circle of competence — The edge matters more than the size. Everyone hears it as a licence to stay small. The working part is the sentence after it, and it is about the edge.
- [Warren Buffett · You find out at low tide](https://ourword.ai/en/i/buffett/swimming-naked/): Warren Buffett · You find out at low tide — Risk shows up late, on purpose. In a rising market every stroke looks good. The question is how to see the risk while it is still invisible.
- [John Cacioppo · Loneliness is a kind of hunger](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cacioppo/loneliness-is-a-signal/): John Cacioppo · Loneliness is a kind of hunger — A signal, not a personality. What loneliness actually is. Why thirty years of research put it in the same category as hunger and thirst.
- [John Cacioppo · Loneliness makes you misread faces](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cacioppo/hypervigilance/): John Cacioppo · Loneliness makes you misread faces — The more watchful, the more alone. Why loneliness feeds itself. The loop Cacioppo found, and where you can cut it.
- [John Cacioppo · More socialising doesn't fix it](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cacioppo/not-more-socializing/): John Cacioppo · More socialising doesn't fix it — The meta-analysis ranks it third. The most common advice for loneliness performs worst. What came first in the data.
- [Julius Caesar · The die is cast](https://ourword.ai/en/i/caesar/the-rubicon/): Julius Caesar · The die is cast — The step that has no way back. Taking an army across that small river meant civil war. This one is about what he was calculating while he stood there.
- [Julius Caesar · Mercy as a weapon](https://ourword.ai/en/i/caesar/clementia/): Julius Caesar · Mercy as a weapon — A new way of winning. In the civil war he killed no prisoners and confiscated no property. He set out his motive plainly in a letter.
- [Tending the Roots of Wisdom · Leave a step on the narrow path](https://ourword.ai/en/i/caigentan/leave-a-step/): Tending the Roots of Wisdom · Leave a step on the narrow path — What you give up is your own way back. You are tight with everyone and tired either way. This asks why the book files giving way under making your own life lighter.
- [Tending the Roots of Wisdom · Keep the skill out of sight](https://ourword.ai/en/i/caigentan/hide-the-edge/): Tending the Roots of Wisdom · Keep the skill out of sight — Not all of what you have has to be on display. Afraid of being found out, and unable to stop proving yourself. This asks what the book offers as somewhere to stand.
- [Tending the Roots of Wisdom · Do not measure them by yourself](https://ourword.ai/en/i/caigentan/dont-measure-by-yourself/): Tending the Roots of Wisdom · Do not measure them by yourself — Where the sourness at good news comes from. Someone close does well and something in you goes cold. This asks where the book puts the root of it.
- [Cal Newport · Attention Residue](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cal-newport/attention-residue/): Cal Newport · Attention Residue — The cost is not those few minutes. What one quick look actually costs. How the account should be worked out.
- [Cal Newport · Book the Block](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cal-newport/schedule-the-depth/): Cal Newport · Book the Block — The gap will not appear on its own. The thing you will do when you have time never starts. How to take the time instead.
- [Cao Cao · Ability only, character not examined](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cao-cao/talent-only/): Cao Cao · Ability only, character not examined — One test, and it is a hard one. He announced in public that he would look at ability and not at conduct. Under what conditions that extreme rule holds.
- [Cao Cao · Grow the grain yourself](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cao-cao/military-farming/): Cao Cao · Grow the grain yourself — Fix your own supply first. The same collapse, and every warlord was seizing food. What he did instead was the thing nobody else had patience for.
- [Cao Cao · Burning the letters at Guandu](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cao-cao/burning-the-letters/): Cao Cao · Burning the letters at Guandu — Some accounts must not be settled. A stack of evidence in hand, enough to name everyone who hedged against you. Why he burned it in front of everybody.
- [Carl Rogers · Unconditional positive regard](https://ourword.ai/en/i/carl-rogers/unconditional-regard/): Carl Rogers · Unconditional positive regard — Accept the person, judge the act. Unconditional sounds like having no standards. What exactly is the thing that carries no conditions.
- [Carl Rogers · Say it back until they nod](https://ourword.ai/en/i/carl-rogers/reflective-listening/): Carl Rogers · Say it back until they nod — Empathy is a move, not a sentence. I understand how you feel does nothing at all. What the act of empathy actually consists of.
- [Chris Voss · Say their feeling out loud](https://ourword.ai/en/i/chris-voss/labeling/): Chris Voss · Say their feeling out loud — Name it before you negotiate it. The other side has gone quiet and will not take a call. What Voss says to say first, and why it is not a concession.
- [Chris Voss · You want that's right, not yes](https://ourword.ai/en/i/chris-voss/thats-right/): Chris Voss · You want that's right, not yes — Two kinds of agreement, nothing alike. They nodded and nothing moved afterwards. This is about telling which of the two agreements you actually walked out with.
- [Chu Shijian · Up the mountain at seventy-four](https://ourword.ai/en/i/chu-shijian/orchard-at-74/): Chu Shijian · Up the mountain at seventy-four — Beginning one thing from zero. Is it too late to begin at this age? What he decided in the year he turned seventy-four, and the arithmetic behind it.
- [Chu Shijian · Oranges take five years](https://ourword.ai/en/i/chu-shijian/oranges-take-five-years/): Chu Shijian · Oranges take five years — He had done the sums before planting. Everything is invested and nothing is visible for years. What he did with that stretch, and why it was not waiting.
- [Chu Shijian · The one thing he carried out](https://ourword.ai/en/i/chu-shijian/what-he-kept/): Chu Shijian · The one thing he carried out — Running a thing properly. Strip away the position and the title and what is left of a person. What he carried from the cigarette factory to the hillside.
- [Winston Churchill · The wilderness years](https://ourword.ai/en/i/churchill/wilderness-years/): Winston Churchill · The wilderness years — The decade nobody called him. Shut out, nobody consulting you, and no end in sight. What Churchill did with each of those days.
- [Winston Churchill · Saying it and nobody listening](https://ourword.ai/en/i/churchill/no-one-listened/): Winston Churchill · Saying it and nobody listening — He put it in a form you could check. You see something others haven't, you say it, nobody listens. How he said it during those years.
- [Winston Churchill · The year he turned sixty-five](https://ourword.ai/en/i/churchill/sixty-five/): Winston Churchill · The year he turned sixty-five — The call came a decade later. You've been accumulating a long time with no way out in sight. What the day he was waiting for actually required.
- [The Crowd · The person who walks into a crowd](https://ourword.ai/en/i/crowd/descent-in-crowds/): The Crowd · The person who walks into a crowd — The steps all go downward. Why do decent people in a group do things none of them would do alone? Le Bon lays out three steps down.
- [The Crowd · Affirm, repeat, infect](https://ourword.ai/en/i/crowd/assert-repeat-contaminate/): The Crowd · Affirm, repeat, infect — The three moves that persuade a crowd. He reduced the demagogue's method to three verbs. This is why the recipe works, and what defence is left.
- [Crucial Conversations · Safety before content](https://ourword.ai/en/i/crucial-conversations/safety-first/): Crucial Conversations · Safety before content — An unsafe person takes in nothing. Every sentence you say is correct and the other person keeps retreating. What has to stop at that moment.
- [Crucial Conversations · Start with heart](https://ourword.ai/en/i/crucial-conversations/start-with-heart/): Crucial Conversations · Start with heart — Settle what you actually want. Halfway through the row you no longer remember what you set out to fix. How the goal got swapped.
- [C.S. Lewis · Nobody told me grief felt like fear](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cs-lewis/grief-feels-like-fear/): C.S. Lewis · Nobody told me grief felt like fear — A Grief Observed. What the feeling actually is when you've just lost someone. Why Lewis called it fear, and what that's for.
- [C.S. Lewis · My faith turned out to be a house of cards](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cs-lewis/house-of-cards/): C.S. Lewis · My faith turned out to be a house of cards — You find out when it's knocked down. What held you up your whole life didn't hold this time. What Lewis wrote when he found that out about himself.
- [C.S. Lewis · I'm afraid of replacing her with my memory of her](https://ourword.ai/en/i/cs-lewis/not-replacing-her/): C.S. Lewis · I'm afraid of replacing her with my memory of her — The harder you grip, the more it warps. You're afraid time will erase them. Lewis found the opposite problem, and it frightened him more.
- [Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi · The Channel at the Edge of Your Skill](https://ourword.ai/en/i/csikszentmihalyi/flow-channel/): Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi · The Channel at the Edge of Your Skill — Too hard is anxiety, too easy is boredom. The same task can make you lose track of time or make you squirm. What makes the difference.
- [Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi · The Best Moments Are Not in Your Leisure](https://ourword.ai/en/i/csikszentmihalyi/leisure-paradox/): Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi · The Best Moments Are Not in Your Leisure — The data contradicted the common sense. Everyone assumes leisure is where the happiness is. Why the recorded results came out the other way.
- [Marie Curie · She took over his course](https://ourword.ai/en/i/curie/the-lecture/): Marie Curie · She took over his course — Starting where he stopped. The person who mattered most is suddenly gone and the days still have to continue. What she did seven months later.
- [Marie Curie · A notebook written to the dead](https://ourword.ai/en/i/curie/journal-of-grief/): Marie Curie · A notebook written to the dead — What you can't say aloud, write to him. There are things you cannot say to a living person. Where those go. What she put in the notebook that year.
- [Marie Curie · The little Curies](https://ourword.ai/en/i/curie/the-little-curies/): Marie Curie · The little Curies — Put the skill where it's needed now. Your skill and what's in front of you don't match. Where she put hers when the war started.
- [Ray Dalio · Pain plus reflection](https://ourword.ai/en/i/dalio/pain-plus-reflection/): Ray Dalio · Pain plus reflection — What 1982 actually cost him. He destroyed his own firm and later called it one of the best things that ever happened to him. The step in between is the point.
- [Ray Dalio · Weigh the opinion, do not count it](https://ourword.ai/en/i/dalio/believability/): Ray Dalio · Weigh the opinion, do not count it — Neither a vote nor a verdict. He rejects the boss deciding and he rejects one person one vote. What replaces them is a weighting, and it needs a record to run on.
- [Peter Drucker · The purpose is to create a customer](https://ourword.ai/en/i/drucker/create-a-customer/): Peter Drucker · The purpose is to create a customer — Defining the business from the outside in. Ask why a business exists and most people answer profit. Why he called that answer not merely wrong but harmful.
- [Peter Drucker · Doing efficiently what should not be done](https://ourword.ai/en/i/drucker/right-things-first/): Peter Drucker · Doing efficiently what should not be done — Effectiveness comes before efficiency. He pulled apart two words that get used interchangeably. Why a gain in efficiency can conceal an error of direction.
- [Du Fu · Ten Years in Chang'an](https://ourword.ai/en/i/du-fu/ten-years-in-changan/): Du Fu · Ten Years in Chang'an — At dawn the rich man's gate, at dusk his horses' dust. What ten years of not getting there actually looks like, and what Du Fu did with the record of it.
- [Du Fu · I Came In and Heard Wailing](https://ourword.ai/en/i/du-fu/the-child-who-starved/): Du Fu · I Came In and Heard Wailing — He wrote the thing he least wanted to write. Something happened that you are ashamed of. Whether to say it. Why Du Fu put his son's death into a poem.
- [Du Fu · Forty-eight, a Hut in Chengdu](https://ourword.ai/en/i/du-fu/the-thatched-hut/): Du Fu · Forty-eight, a Hut in Chengdu — Build a roof, not a position. Is it too late to begin again in middle age. What Du Fu did first after he walked away, and what he wrote.
- [Duan Yongping · Do the right thing, then do the thing right](https://ourword.ai/en/i/duan-yongping/right-things-done-right/): Duan Yongping · Do the right thing, then do the thing right — The two halves have an order. He has repeated one sentence for decades. Why its halves cannot be swapped, and what the stop-doing list is for.
- [Duan Yongping · Dare to be last](https://ourword.ai/en/i/duan-yongping/dare-to-be-last/): Duan Yongping · Dare to be last — Come first from behind. Everybody races to launch first; he says openly that he aims to be last. Under what conditions late is an advantage.
- [Carol Dweck · Praise the process, not the talent](https://ourword.ai/en/i/dweck/praise-the-process/): Carol Dweck · Praise the process, not the talent — Praising cleverness makes people avoid challenge. One sentence of praise changes what a child picks next. This piece is about where the change happens.
- [Carol Dweck · The effect is much smaller than the popular story](https://ourword.ai/en/i/dweck/effect-size/): Carol Dweck · The effect is much smaller than the popular story — The boundary worth drawing. The concept got told as a master key. This piece is about how big it actually is.
- [Albert Einstein · Changing the question](https://ourword.ai/en/i/einstein/formulating-the-problem/): Albert Einstein · Changing the question — The answer's ceiling is set by the question. The line comes from a book he wrote, not from a quotation card. What matters is how he used it himself.
- [Albert Einstein · The patent office years](https://ourword.ai/en/i/einstein/patent-office/): Albert Einstein · The patent office years — What the margin buys you. In 1905 he published four papers that changed physics. His job title was technical examiner, third class.
- [Epictetus · Sort it before you feel anything](https://ourword.ai/en/i/epictetus/dichotomy/): Epictetus · Sort it before you feel anything — The handbook opens with a filing rule, not with advice. The one Stoic line everybody knows, put back where it starts: as the first operation, before the appraisal and before the feeling.

- [Shi Tiesheng · Once Born, No Longer Open to Debate](https://ourword.ai/en/i/shi-tiesheng/not-a-question-to-debate/): Shi Tiesheng · Once Born, No Longer Open to Debate — The Temple of Earth and I. Whether to keep asking why this happened to you. Which questions Shi Tiesheng closed during fifteen years in a park.

How to lay out a day around a long illness. What Shi Tiesheng meant by calling illness his profession, and how to use it.
- [Shi Tiesheng · Death Is a Festival That Will Certainly Arrive](https://ourword.ai/en/i/shi-tiesheng/death-is-not-urgent/): Shi Tiesheng · Death Is a Festival That Will Certainly Arrive — Nothing to hurry toward. For people who lie awake until dawn thinking about dying. Why Shi Tiesheng called death a festival, and what that did for him.
- [Sima Qian · Why he did not kill himself](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sima-qian/letter-to-ren-an/): Sima Qian · Why he did not kill himself — The letter to Ren An. The convention was clear and he broke it. Years later he wrote one man a letter explaining exactly why.
- [Sima Qian · Those books were all written at the worst time](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sima-qian/written-in-adversity/): Sima Qian · Those books were all written at the worst time — King Wen was in captivity when he expanded the Changes. One paragraph of the letter is almost entirely a list of names. What the names have in common is not talent.
- [Sima Qian · Staying alive takes one unfinished thing](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sima-qian/one-thing-to-finish/): Sima Qian · Staying alive takes one unfinished thing — To complete the words of one school. The task he set himself was absurdly large. That size is doing work, and so is the fact that he did not choose it.
- [Sima Yi · A thousand li in eight days](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sima-yi/eight-days/): Sima Yi · A thousand li in eight days — Their schedule is built on your procedure. Your opponent has your arrival time worked out precisely. What he got wrong is not the distance but whether you keep to the rules.
- [Sima Yi · Waiting for the moment that will not repeat](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sima-yi/waiting/): Sima Yi · Waiting for the moment that will not repeat — Wait until they stop watching. How far do you have to take feigned weakness before it works? This is about the moment the porridge went down his chest.
- [Jim Simons · Slaves to the model](https://ourword.ai/en/i/simons/slave-to-the-model/): Jim Simons · Slaves to the model — Discipline handed to the system. The best-returning fund on record forbids its brilliant people from improvising. This piece asks who that rule is actually protecting against.
- [Jim Simons · Beauty, and the best people](https://ourword.ai/en/i/simons/simons-principles/): Jim Simons · Beauty, and the best people — He published his own principles. A man who made his fortune out of algorithms summed up a career in five principles. Not one of them is about mathematics.
- [Socrates · Not supposing that you know](https://ourword.ai/en/i/socrates/knowing-not-knowing/): Socrates · Not supposing that you know — The whole margin is that thin. The poster says he knew that he knew nothing. This page is about the narrower and far more useful thing he said.
- [Socrates · The midwife's trade](https://ourword.ai/en/i/socrates/midwifery/): Socrates · The midwife's trade — No answers, only delivery. His mother delivered babies and he said he had inherited the trade. This page is about why he withheld answers.
- [George Soros · Reflexivity](https://ourword.ai/en/i/soros/reflexivity/): George Soros · Reflexivity — Perception rewrites the thing. Textbooks say prices reflect fundamentals. This piece asks why Soros says the arrow runs both ways, and how that loop manufactures a bubble.
- [George Soros · Knowing when you're wrong](https://ourword.ai/en/i/soros/knowing-when-wrong/): George Soros · Knowing when you're wrong — Not right or wrong, but how much. A man famous for enormous bets credits his survival to admitting mistakes. This piece asks why those two things are not in conflict.
- [The Sovereign Individual · The logic of violence](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sovereign-individual/logic-of-violence/): The Sovereign Individual · The logic of violence — Institutions follow costs. This book explains a thousand years of institutions without ideas and without great men. One variable does the whole job.
- [The Sovereign Individual · From citizen to customer](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sovereign-individual/citizen-to-customer/): The Sovereign Individual · From citizen to customer — Jurisdictions start competing. Written in 1997, the book predicts governments will have to compete. This is the chain that gets them there, and who pays.

The man sent to collect the debts burned the contracts instead. This is about how that apparently pure loss was finally settled.

Wife, concubine and guest all said he was the handsomer man. This is about the three different things he heard in one answer.
- [Su Shi · No wind, no rain, no sun](https://ourword.ai/en/i/su-shi/no-wind-no-rain/): Su Shi · No wind, no rain, no sun — Switching off the scoring. Everyone else on the road was miserable. He was not. What exactly did he switch off in that moment?
- [Su Shi · Huangzhou, Huizhou, Danzhou](https://ourword.ai/en/i/su-shi/three-exiles/): Su Shi · Huangzhou, Huizhou, Danzhou — Doing real work where you were sent to rot. Asked at the end of his life to name what he'd accomplished, he named three places he'd been banished to. Why those?
- [Su Shi · I see no bad people](https://ourword.ai/en/i/su-shi/no-bad-people/): Su Shi · I see no bad people — Treating a person as a person. A man whose enemies nearly had him executed said he could see no bad people anywhere. This is not naivety.

The name of the campaign came from his telegram. This is about how an operation got enlarged into a decisive battle while it was running.
- [Sun Tzu · Win first, then fight](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sun-tzu/win-before-fighting/): Sun Tzu · Win first, then fight — The work happens before the clash. Everyone quotes it as bravado. Read slowly it says the opposite: by the time you are fighting, it is mostly decided.
- [Sun Tzu · Know both, and know which is harder](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sun-tzu/know-both/): Sun Tzu · Know both, and know which is harder — Your own numbers are the flattered ones. Quoted for two thousand years, usually as a case for research. The half everybody skips is the one about yourself.
- [Sun Tzu · The best fight is the one nobody has](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sun-tzu/win-without-fighting/): Sun Tzu · The best fight is the one nobody has — Winning a hundred times is not the top of the list. A hundred victories sounds like the ceiling. He says it isn't, and the reason is arithmetic rather than modesty.
- [Sun Tzu · The flank only works if the front holds](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sun-tzu/orthodox-and-surprise/): Sun Tzu · The flank only works if the front holds — A clever move on its own is a donation. Everyone wants the unexpected move. The chapter is mostly about the unglamorous thing it has to stand on.
- [Sun Tzu · Take the shape of what you meet](https://ourword.ai/en/i/sun-tzu/form-like-water/): Sun Tzu · Take the shape of what you meet — Avoiding the strong part is the hard half. 'Be like water' became a poster. The chapter is stricter than the poster, and most of it is about what not to do.
- [Nassim Taleb · The turkey problem](https://ourword.ai/en/i/taleb/turkey-problem/): Nassim Taleb · The turkey problem — The evidence peaks just before the break. What conclusion does a turkey reach if it thinks statistically? This piece asks why the day with the most evidence is the day before the accident.
- [Nassim Taleb · Skin in the game](https://ourword.ai/en/i/taleb/skin-in-the-game/): Nassim Taleb · Skin in the game — Read the position, not the opinion. He revived a very old filter. This piece asks why advice from someone who bears none of the consequences should be discounted automatically.
- [Tao Te Ching · Whatever peaks, turns](https://ourword.ai/en/i/tao-te-ching/reversal/): Tao Te Ching · Whatever peaks, turns — The top is where to start worrying. Usually read as comfort for bad times. It is more useful as an instrument, and it is sharpest when things are going well.
- [Tao Te Ching · The part you don't do](https://ourword.ai/en/i/tao-te-ching/wu-wei/): Tao Te Ching · The part you don't do — A list of moves to leave out. Usually translated as non-action and read as passivity. It is closer to a list of the moves that make things worse.
- [Tao Te Ching · Go to the low ground](https://ourword.ai/en/i/tao-te-ching/water/): Tao Te Ching · Go to the low ground — Not competing is a choice of location. Water has been praised for two thousand years. The text credits it with one specific thing, and it is about position.
- [Tao Te Ching · The empty part is the useful part](https://ourword.ai/en/i/tao-te-ching/usefulness-of-emptiness/): Tao Te Ching · The empty part is the useful part — What you left out is doing the work. Which part of a wheel is doing the work? The chapter is short enough to be a definition and it underwrites the whole book.
- [Tao Yuanming · Eighty Days as Magistrate](https://ourword.ai/en/i/tao-yuanming/eighty-days/): Tao Yuanming · Eighty Days as Magistrate — What he resigned was that day, not the office. Whether to turn now or wait for a better moment. Why Tao Yuanming left after eighty days instead of finishing the term.

- [Peter Thiel · Competition is for losers](https://ourword.ai/en/i/thiel/competition-is-for-losers/): Peter Thiel · Competition is for losers — Both sides lie, in opposite directions. Business school teaches you to compete. He says competing is the loss. The usable part is how to hear through what both sides say.

He opens with a question that has no model answer. What it is screening for, and what a good answer looks like.
- [Thinking, Fast and Slow · What you see is all there is](https://ourword.ai/en/i/thinking-fast-and-slow/wysiati/): Thinking, Fast and Slow · What you see is all there is — Nothing announces the missing information. Kahneman gave the mind's largest defect an acronym. This page is about why ignorance produces no sensation at all.
- [Thinking, Fast and Slow · Losses loom larger](https://ourword.ai/en/i/thinking-fast-and-slow/loss-aversion/): Thinking, Fast and Slow · Losses loom larger — Losing hurts about twice as much. The same hundred hurts about twice as much going out as coming in. This page is about what that decides for you.
- [Thinking in Systems · Structure drives behaviour](https://ourword.ai/en/i/thinking-in-systems/structure-drives-behavior/): Thinking in Systems · Structure drives behaviour — Stop blaming the parts. - [Thomas Gordon · The I-message](https://ourword.ai/en/i/thomas-gordon/i-message/): Thomas Gordon · The I-message — Say the effect, not the character. The same event, said one way, starts a fight; said another, starts action. Where the structural difference is.

- [Lev Vygotsky · The zone of proximal development](https://ourword.ai/en/i/vygotsky/zpd/): Lev Vygotsky · The zone of proximal development — Look at the second line. Two people at the same level today may end up far apart. Which measure the difference shows up in.

- [Wang Yangming · Knowing and doing are one thing](https://ourword.ai/en/i/wang-yangming/unity-of-knowing-and-doing/): Wang Yangming · Knowing and doing are one thing — Not done means not known. 'I understand it, I just can't do it.' Wang Yangming argued that the sentence itself is the error.
- [Wang Yangming · You are polished by events](https://ourword.ai/en/i/wang-yangming/polish-on-things/): Wang Yangming · You are polished by events — Sitting still trains nothing. Someone said he felt perfectly steady sitting quietly and fell apart the moment anything happened. Why that steadiness doesn't count.

Most of what we call being unable to decide is being unwilling to admit. Why he said the judgement is already there.

A tsar refused railways; an emperor refused factories. This is why the people blocking a technology are the ones who understand it.

- [Zeng Guofan · Solid camp, dull fight](https://ourword.ai/en/i/zeng-guofan/solid-camp-dull-fight/): Zeng Guofan · Solid camp, dull fight — A clumsy method that removes the uncertainty.
